performance_case.causal_mechanism: Resolving one explicitly named source-readiness blocker from exact accepted transport and deterministic parser evidence prevents stale branch closure and makes the next factor-semantic question falsifiable without selecting a factor post outcome.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that the accepted CFTC CME Bitcoin TFF headerless transport, source design and disabled V2 package together satisfy the predecessor audit's source-contract-ready condition for one later factor-semantic review. It proves no future availability, operational capture, source registration, factor formula, predictive value, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS authority, deployment or Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future path-risk improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until one separately preregistered factor passes forward predictive, equal-capital economic and drawdown-path gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded read-only delta review prevents repeating the four-family source audit or another parser loop. If positive, the next spend is capped at one factor-semantic readiness review; if not, the branch waits on one exact named proof while R2 continues independently.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The knowledge value is reducing source-selection latency and engineering churn while preserving a strict boundary between source readiness and alpha evidence.
